about: Invented. Two nights: phase 1 is consolidated, then the listed conversations are edited in place (a revision) and a second night is drained. Each story names what the edit changes (`expect`): the new value current, the old one in no open claim under any predicate, what another conversation says untouched. Every name, place and date is invented.

conversations.title: Dario's move
turns: My brother Dario is moving to Ghent to start a new job at a shipyard.
Congratulations to him! When does he move?
On {day:+40}, when his flat lease ends. He asked me to help with the move that day, so I'm borrowing a van.
